ground_truth: Room 22.0 [kitchen] is closest. Its nearest Floor B restroom-type room is Room 3.0 [bathroom] at about 1.74 m. For comparison, Room 23.0 [kitchen] is closest to Room 29.0 [shower] at about 5.93 m.

text: Which two rooms on Floor C have the closest center-to-center distance?
ground_truth: Room 5.0 [bathroom] and Room 9.0 [bedroom] are the closest pair on Floor C, about 2.24 m apart.

ground_truth: Room 23.0 is better equipped: it has a cup, bowl, banana, two ovens, a sink, and a refrigerator. Room 22.0 only has a cup and a refrigerator, with no sink or heating/cooking object listed.

text: Which floor has the largest chair-only seating capacity, counting each chair as one seat?
ground_truth: Floor B has the largest chair-only seating capacity with 24 chairs. Floor A has 10 chairs and Floor C has 9 chairs.
